I totally agree with the guy host and completely disagree with Adriano saying that these covered call ETF's are also good for 20 year old's.  That added 25% leverage is unnecessary risk for someone who doesn't need the money now whether you drip or reinvest the distributions.  Also these ETF's have much higher fees for the options trading and leverage. We don't know how these will behave in a long bear market or if interest rates go higher... more risk that these will underperform the underlying in the long run, why start buying these at very young ages.  So what if you have to sell the growth stocks later to then transition into buying these covered call ETF's as you reach retirement, he makes it sound like its so complicated, like seriously lol.  If the younger person wants to pay for leverage then they should buy the S&P growth index for example or Nasdaq etc. but with 25% added leverage, .yes you'll pay for the leverage as well but at least you would be doing it with the goal of having better average returns.  Adriano is doing a disservice to younger investors, promoting it to them.
